title: Keel Policy
description: The versioned rules file of the Keel development model. The classifier in core/policy receives this document and a unified diff and returns charges, findings and a mode; the version here travels with every verdict so a refusal can be replayed and a penalty audited. Bump `version` in the same commit as any rule change.

version.description: Carried in every Classification. A verdict without it cannot name the rules it was judged under.

card.description: Bounds on the contract card an agent loads instead of the tree. A card over any bound is refused before it is read (keel.card.*).

surface.description: What one node may bring into existence without a declared allowance. Zero is a budget.

maxAllowance.description: The ceiling on what a promise may declare at planning time. The classifier caps a declared allowance here before adding it to `surface`.

maxFileLinesDelta.description: Added lines one file may receive in one diff; above it the change is refused as keel.body.oversized_change. The stand-in for a parser this slice does not have.

ladder.description: How drift would change the write surface a seat may use next: full -> contract_only -> patch_only -> propose_only. Applied only when enabled.

enabled.description: Off until a controlled comparison shows penalties add value over guidance alone; while off the rung is reported, never applied.

strikesPerRung.description: Net strikes (drifts minus credits, never below zero) per rung dropped. Zero would be a ladder that never demotes and is refused here.

windowNodes.description: How many of the seat's most recent node records the fold reads.

surfaceEnforcement.description: Whether surface budgets and the per-file cap refuse the diff (block) or only report findings (signal). Objective contracts block in either mode.
